cmd: .pim/bin/python -u scripts/bayes_floor.py && .pim/bin/python -u scripts/score_prediction.py && for r in initial_othello_comparison/L-oth-20m adjacent_flip_ablation/L-oth-adjacent-flip-20m adjacency_ablation/L-oth-adjacent-20m noise_ablation/L-dw-noiseless-20m ray_ablation/L-dw-128ray-20m ray_ablation/L-dw-16ray-20m ray_ablation/L-dw-8ray-20m ray_ablation/L-dw-5ray-20m; do .pim/bin/python -u scripts/index_ceiling.py --run $r --reachability || exit 1; done && .pim/bin/python .pim/bin/jupyter-nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace --ExecutePreprocessor.timeout=-1 notebooks/build_appendix_tables_and_figs.ipynb
note: Bayes floors (4 Othello exact + 6 discworld sampled) -> runs/_baselines/<inst>/bayes_floor.json; prediction block folded into every scored run; appendix notebook (Table A1) re-rendered. Runs AFTER final_tables so no master_eval is writing scores.json at the same time. Also the Edit Index ceilings (scripts/index_ceiling.py → runs/<run>/index_ceiling.json; Othello with --reachability = legal vs illegal targets; oth-noflip has no reachable flipped board and dw-blink is refused by design, so both are left out).
